# BuilderSpace

BuilderSpace — Midwest Builder Tour: hackathons, build weekends, pitch nights and speaker
spaces, with free training resources for new founders. San Francisco startup teams travel to
Louisiana and Nebraska to train alongside local builders and help local economies in areas
seeing new data centres and jobs.

Status, stated plainly: **everything here is PLANNED.** All 16 events are currently
Private/unlisted on Luma, no invites have been sent, and **no venue, sponsor, speaker, or
partner is confirmed**. Locations for in-person events are TBD unless marked Online. This
file will never list a venue or sponsor that hasn't signed.

- Site: https://builderspace.tech/ (GitHub Pages)
- Contact (humans and agents): events@builderspace.tech
- Sponsorship inquiries: sponsors@builderspace.tech (alias of the same mailbox)
- Human steward: Mike Rice. Registration for agents is email-based and human-gated — see /auth.md.

Final details are confirmed on Luma as they land.

## The roadmap

- Phase 0 (Nov 12 – Dec 17, 2026) — Onboarding, online: form the community before anyone travels.
- Phase 1 (Jan 8 – Mar 7, 2027) — Louisiana: New Orleans (Kickoff, Bayou AI Build Weekend,
  Founder Toolkit, NOLA Builder Night) and Lafayette (Cajun Code Sprint). Heartland Builders &
  Coffee (Feb 18) is grouped in this leg; its city is not yet named in the plan.
- Phase 2 (Mar 26 – Apr 15, 2027) — Nebraska: Omaha and Lincoln are the plan's anchor cities;
  individual Nebraska event cities are not yet assigned in the records.
- Phase 3 (Apr 22 – May 1, 2027) — Certify & close: Skills & Certs Day, then the Grand Finale.

"What success looks like" on the site is the plan's aspiration, framed as goals — never as
commitments or confirmed partners.

## Founder training & resources

The tour's second job is training new founders. On the site:
- "How to Get Credits for Startup Founders" — a nine-guide series on stacking startup credits
  honestly (the map, cloud, infra/dev tools, AI credits, business tools, the nonprofit track,
  rejections, redeeming & tracking). Amounts are "up to" maximums; confirm terms with each
  provider the day you apply. The guides are being published as resource pages by the AGI
  Future Foundation; links on the site are placeholders until that push lands.
- A startup credits & programs catalogue, a credits audit of real application outcomes, and
  an application prep library — all grounded in real applications, approvals, and rejections.

## Sponsorship

The tour is seeking sponsors — cash and/or product credits. In return the tour team works as
the sponsor's brand ambassadors and developer-relations crew on the road: workshops and demos
on the sponsor's tools, the sponsor's stack in the curriculum, hackathon tracks and judging,
tour content, and first access to the builders being trained. All sponsorship numbers are
proposed and negotiable; **no amounts are published here because none are set** — tier
amounts on file are blank placeholders the steward fills. Nothing is promised, and no sponsor
is named until they've signed. Inquiries: sponsors@builderspace.tech.

## Discovery files

Machine-readable files for agents on this site:
- /agents.json — catalogue of what is offered to agents and humans, with contacts.
- /agent.json — the steward protocol in structured form.
- /auth.md — agent registration (email-based, human-gated; no token, no OAuth/OIDC).
- /.well-known/ai-catalog.json — agent resource discovery manifest.
- /.well-known/api-catalog — resource/discovery linkset (this site has no API; the linkset lists real documents only).
- /sitemap.xml — every page (currently one page).
No OpenAPI spec, no status/health endpoint, no MCP server, and no OAuth/OIDC discovery
documents exist for this site. Markdown content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown) is
planned via a Cloudflare Worker once the domain is proxied — until then, this file is the
Markdown homepage.

## Agent rules

Agents may summarize, cite, and route inquiries to a human steward. Agents may NOT commit
BuilderSpace or the steward, move funds, sign, book, or represent themselves as BuilderSpace.
Sponsorship, venue, and speaker agreements are made by humans, in writing, only. Every first
step is steward-gated: write to events@builderspace.tech with a subject starting [Agent],
naming your operator and human principal.
